g.text: Mean earnings in urban Sindh rise with age, peaking at Rs 55-59)

Source: PSLM 2019-20, person file. Sample: earners aged 15-64, Sindh urban, weighted by household weight. Large markers = weighted band means; hollow = band with fewer than 30 observations. Two earners outside Rs 10,000-10,000,000 are not shown.
